description: Separate task artifact requirements from check verdict marker validation in workflow definitions and runner diagnostics.

tasks.title: Clarify task artifact expectation contract
tasks.description: Update workflow task expectation types, schema names, and definition loading so task expectations describe required artifact files and optional neutral artifact markers only. Ensure PASS/FAIL-style verdict markers are not represented as task completion requirements in the clarified contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Task expectation model uses artifact-focused names for required files and optional artifact content markers.
Task artifact validation has no pass/fail verdict semantics in its public contract.
Definition loading rejects or clearly diagnoses PASS/FAIL-like markers if they are configured as task artifact requirements.
tasks.output: Updated workflow task expectation schema/types and loader behavior
tasks.notes: Keep compatibility localized to definition loading only if existing checked-in definitions require it; do not preserve ambiguous runtime semantics.

tasks.title: Move built-in profiles to artifact language
tasks.description: Update built-in workflow profile definitions so tasks require artifact files and optional neutral artifact content only. Keep pass verdict markers such as PASS and <promise>PASS</promise> exclusively in check definitions.
acceptanceCriteria: No built-in task artifact expectation requires PASS, FAIL, <promise>PASS</promise>, or <promise>FAIL</promise>.
Checks that need pass evidence still declare the required verdict marker in check-specific fields.
The ai-review task and review-passed check model review.md with <promise>FAIL</promise> as a check failure, not a task artifact failure.
tasks.notes: Do not change prompts unless profile/runtime code exposes an unavoidable contract mismatch.

tasks.title: Separate artifact and verdict validation diagnostics
tasks.description: Update runtime validation boundaries so task artifact failures and check verdict failures are evaluated and reported through distinct domain paths. Wrap or translate low-level marker errors before they reach runner-facing diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing task artifact files produce diagnostics that identify missing artifact file requirements.
Missing neutral task artifact markers produce diagnostics that identify missing artifact markers, not verdict failures.
Missing or mismatched required pass verdict markers produce diagnostics that identify the failing check and expected verdict marker.
A review.md file containing <promise>FAIL</promise> fails review-passed as a check verdict failure and is not reported as an ai-review artifact marker failure.
tasks.output: Updated runner/workflow validation and error messages
tasks.notes: Shared marker utilities may remain, but their raw messages should not leak across task/check validation boundaries.

tasks.title: Cover artifact expectations and verdict checks separately
tasks.description: Add focused tests that independently verify task required files, neutral task artifact markers, and check PASS marker validation. Include the regression where review.md exists with <promise>FAIL</promise> and the failure is attributed to review-passed check verdict validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover missing required task artifact file diagnostics.
Tests cover missing neutral task artifact marker diagnostics without requiring PASS verdict evidence.
Tests cover required PASS marker validation in the check execution path.
A regression test asserts <promise>FAIL</promise> in review.md is not reported as a missing ai-review task artifact marker.
tasks.output: Updated automated test coverage for workflow definitions and validation
tasks.notes: Prefer focused server/runner tests over a single broad end-to-end test so the domain paths stay distinct.

tasks.title: Verify workflow change end to end
tasks.description: Run the relevant server, runner, and build verification commands after implementation. Confirm the clarified profile definitions, validation behavior, and diagnostics work together without changing workflow stage transitions, APIs, storage, or prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: Relevant automated tests for workflow definitions and workflow engine validation pass.
A project build or equivalent verification passes, or any unrelated existing failures are documented.
No prompt, API, storage, dependency, or stage-transition changes are introduced for this issue.
tasks.notes: Run the narrow tests first, then a full build if practical.
